svg.title: The three layers in ARIAC
svg.desc: The course stack drawn as boxes. Top, in blue: Deliberative (your team), GP3 PDDL planner, and in GP4 an LLM agent. Below it, in amber: Executive (your team), the GP1 behavior tree in py_trees_ros. Below that, in green: Skills (the course), pick and place as ROS 2 actions on MoveIt 2. At the bottom, in green: Reactive (ARIAC), the controllers, grippers, conveyor, testers, AGVs and sensors. Arrows go down on the left and up on the right between the layers. A separate arrow goes from the executive straight down to ARIAC, past the skills, labeled /agvN/move and ARIAC services. On the left, a purple Perception box (your team: GP2 lidar defects, GP4 VLM on camera images) receives sensor data from ARIAC and sends its results to the executive and to the deliberative layer.
